package.description: An open-source tool for managing Analysis Services Tabular and Power BI models.

en-US.description: An open-source tool for managing Analysis Services Tabular and Power BI models.
en-US.longDescription: Tabular Editor 2.x is a free, open-source, tool that lets you easily manipulate and manage measures, calculated columns, display folders, perspectives and translations in Analysis Services Tabular and Power BI XMLA Models (from Compatibility Level 1200 and onwards). The tool is written entirely in .NET WinForms (C#).
en-US.name: Tabular Editor

zh-CN.description: 用于管理 Analysis Services 表格和 Power BI 模型的开源工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: Tabular Editor 2.x 是一款免费、开源的工具，可让您轻松地在 Analysis Services 表格和 Power BI XMLA 模型 （兼容性级别 1200 及更高版本）中操作和管理度量值、计算列、显示文件夹、透视和翻译。该工具完全使用 .NET WinForms (C#) 编写。
